description: This file defines the UndoRedoManager class, which manages undo and redo operations for a calculator input state. It utilizes two stacks to keep track of previous and next states for undo/redo functionality.

classes.name: UndoRedoManager
classes.description: Manages undo and redo stacks for calculator input states, supporting adding new states, undo, redo, and state clearing.

methods.name: addState
methods.description: Adds a new input state to the undo stack and clears the redo stack.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Reverts to the previous calculator input state if available, moving the current state to the redo stack.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Restores a previously undone state from the redo stack.

methods.name: canUndo
methods.description: Checks if undo operation is possible based on the undo stack size.

methods.name: canRedo
methods.description: Checks if redo operation is available based on the redo stack.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears both undo and redo stacks, resetting history.
